datasets.title: Microarray gene expression profiling in central neurocytomas
datasets.summary: Microarray gene expression profiling of central neurocytomas (CNs). Comparison between neurocytoma, pineocytoma (PC) and pineoblastoma (PB) relative to normal brain.
datasets.overall_design: Gene expression analysis was performed on tumor samples. Tumor tissues of 5 CNs, 2 PCs (low-grade pineal parenchymal tumors (PPTs)) and 2 PBs (high-grade PPTs) were obtained from the NeurobiotecBank (Groupement Hospitalier Est, Bron, France) or from the AP-HM Tissue Bank (Assistance Publique-Hôpitaux de Marseille, France). At surgery, the tumor tissue was divided into 2 fragments, one of which was frozen and stored in liquid nitrogen for RNA extraction, whereas the other was fixed for histopathologic analysis.

datasets.title: Comparative transcriptomic analysis of Central Neurocytoma-derived tumor spheres as compared to its differentiated cells and fetal SVZ-derived neural stem cells.
datasets._f58a34: SOGEN·索臻生物科技·sogentech.com·增量更新与更多专题在群里·公众号医学僧的科研日记
datasets.summary: We obtained tissues of Central neurocytomas (CNs) from surgeries of patients, and then we performed primary cultures of CN tissues. Tumor spheres of CN were isolated from the differentiated CN cells. Fetal subventricular zone tissues (this sample was derived from inevitable abortion because of fatal defects) were primary cultured as well.  Going forward, we compared the RNA of the pools via microarray to identify markers of tumor stem cells of Central Neurocytomas (CNs) as compared to its differentiated cells and fetal subventricular zone (SVZ)-derived neural stem cells (NSCs) to be able to characterize its origin of CN. Interestingly, CN-tumor spheres have characteristics of Transit amplifying Type C cells and Radial glial cells (RGCs). Moreover CN-tumor spheres expressed well known cancer stem cells markers of glioblastomas.
datasets.overall_design: Use of human CN tumor samples (N=3) for primary cultures in this study was approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of Seoul National University Hospital (IRB approval C-0710-040-223). Attributing to its benign characteristics of CN, only one sample among those three was able to make robust number of tumor spheres were made from one sample after primary culture. Other sample also made tumor spheres, but the amount of RNA was not optimal for the microarray. We compared CN-differentiated cells (N=1) and CN-derived tumor spheres (N=1) to defined specific genes, expressed on CN-tumor spheres. Gene expression of CN-tumor spheres were also compared with Fetal SVZ-derived NSCs to detect overlapped and differential expression. For a comparative study between samples, expression data was standardized using z-score transformation. For a normal control we used “GSM469410” from the public GEO database (http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/).
